title: AlignDiff: Spatiotemporal Alignment for Remote Sensing Image Recovery via Terrain-Aware Diffusion

contributions.purpose: 把遥感影像修复统一为时空对齐问题
contributions.mechanism: 将缺失数据恢复形式化为条件分布 p(x_hat | x_obs, a_spatial, a_dist, a_semantic),统一空间补全(Task-1)与时间补全(Task-2)两任务
contributions.evaluation: 在 Landsat-8 十区域数据集与 EarthNet2021 两个 benchmark 上同一框架完成两类任务
contributions.domain: 遥感影像修复 / 扩散模型
contributions.source_quote: We formulate remote sensing image reconstruction as a spatiotemporal alignment task, unifying spatial and temporal recovery under a structured modeling perspective;

contributions.purpose: 提出地形感知的扩散生成框架 AlignDiff
contributions.mechanism: ControlNet 式分支以 DEM 数字高程模型做物理先验条件,LoRA 注入 <AlignDiff>+地点/日期/波段结构化 prompt 做语义对齐
contributions.evaluation: Task-1 PSNR 23.04±0.69 / RMSE 0.0713±0.004 优于 ControlNet(21.18±0.72 / 0.0873±0.005)与 LaMa/Palette/SD
contributions.source_quote: We propose AlignDiff, a diffusion-based generation framework that integrates terrain priors and prompt-based conditioning to align missing regions with physical and semantic context;

contributions.purpose: 以分布对齐模块修正生成影像的光谱/亮度偏移
contributions.mechanism: VGG-Adapter:VGG-19 特征上做 MMD 分布损失 + Gram 矩阵多层风格损失,约束生成与真实分布一致
contributions.evaluation: Task-2 SSIM 0.5704±0.011(较 ControlNet +50.68%)、RMSE 降 11.56%;消融:无 adapter 时亮度均值 123.63 vs 有 adapter 95.27(GT 95.19);红波段 PSNR +11.01dB
contributions.source_quote: We develop an alignment adapter that enforces distributional consistency, improving generalization across diverse terrain types and missing patterns.

self_declared_provenance.quote: To incorporate physical topography and enforce terrain-aware realism, we adopt a ControlNet-style branch (Zhang, Rao, and Agrawala 2023) that conditions the diffusion process on Digital Elevation Models (DEMs).
AlignDiff improves upon ControlNet by introducing a VGG-based adapter for distribution alignment

notes: desk-reject(AAAI 双栏模板并附 AAAI Reproducibility Checklist,而非 agents4science 模板/AI involvement checklist,疑为改投稿件,或因此被 desk-reject)。trade-off(带数字):Task-1 上 AlignDiff SSIM 0.4563 低于无条件 SD 的 0.5412,论文自认 "Despite slightly lower SSIM, qualitative results show more coherent and terrain-consistent outputs";Reproducibility Checklist 4.12 自答 no(未做统计显著性检验)。其余协议适配正常,贡献三条与实验对应良好。
